''See also: [[Razael Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Razael, also known as the [[Wolf]], is a powerful Judge within the [[Abidan Court]]. A formidable combatant, she is capable of matching high-ranking figures like Ozriel and [[Makiel]] in open battle. She possesses the strength to depopulate an entire [[Iteration]] and has been known to engage in combat that can shake the stars. Her specialized weaponry is a sword designed specifically for executing Class One threats and other [[Judges]]. As a leader within the [[Wolf Division]], she commands destructive powers that are not part of the public record. Razael is characterized by her intense temperament, frequently expressing fury toward other [[Judges]] and showing a refusal to abandon the battlefield. She has historically been involved in significant conflicts, including a bloody battle that resulted in the loss of hundreds of her subordinates and the capture of an [[Iteration]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Razael wields a blazing sword. This Judge is also recognized by the moniker of the [[Wolf]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Razael is capable of matching both [[Makiel]] and Ozriel in combat. Additionally, the [[Wolf]] has engaged in a sword clash with [[Mad King|the Mad King]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Razael utilizes a blazing sword specifically designed to execute Class One threats and other [[Judges]]. This combatant is capable of matching [[Makiel]] and Ozriel in open battle.}}
